m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: What can I do for the mighty Spellbinder?
Huh, I never pegged you for someone who read cheesy books, but I'm sure I can find something you'll like.
Oh, a book about making cheese? Nope. Never heard of one. Why would you even want that? It's for a CurdWright, huh?
If his ancestors were all cheesemakers, maybe there's something useful in the family crypt in the Mausoleum. Start there.
Greetings, Spellbinder! I hear you are able to help people find things. Well I'm in need of something a little different - knowledge.
The elders tell me that I am the last in a line of famous cheesemakers. I want to fulfill my destiny, but I don't know how!
The craft of cheesemaking, like most of the mouse arts, has been forgotten because our culture focused its attention toward war.
I'd love to learn how to make cheese, but I can't find any information about it. Could you help me find a book on cheesemaking?
What a magnificent book! I feel as though I can feel the spirits of my ancestors in every page. And there are so many!
Thank you so much, Spellbinder! The information within the Tome of the Rind will help me fulfill my destiny.
And all my Mouse brethren will be delighted once I can prepare them delicious cheese!
Please help me find some instructions on the ancient art of cheesemaking.
